title: Contributors credited in the dataset

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Stable handle used in translated_by, checked_by, author and reviewed_by. A GitHub username for people who have one, otherwise a lowercase slug of the name chosen at sign-up.

fields.name: credit_name
fields.description: Name as the person wants it shown in credits. Empty when they chose not to be named (the handle is shown instead).

fields.name: github
fields.description: GitHub username. Required for review-board members, who approve pull requests on GitHub.

fields.name: licence_words
fields.description: Licence agreed to for word translations

fields.name: consent_version
fields.description: Version of the consent text the person agreed to, e.g. 2026-11

$comment: PROPOSAL, not in _meta/schema/ yet. For _meta/contributors.tsv. No email addresses or other contact details: those stay in the tool's database and are never committed.
